name: Pectoral implants

lead:
Pectoral implants are solid silicone implants shaped like the pectoralis major, placed through a small incision to give men a fuller, more defined chest. They are used by men who want more chest volume than training gives, by those with asymmetry or a sunken chest, and in reconstruction for conditions such as Poland syndrome.
Published experience is mostly surgeon case series, such as a 2008 report on 21 patients with custom-made implants who were satisfied with the results.

paras: The implant is selected or custom-made to match the person's chest dimensions and inserted by a plastic surgeon, typically under general anaesthesia, with a recovery period afterwards. Surgeons often pair it with treatment of gynecomastia where needed.

As with other implant surgery, risks include infection, bleeding, fluid collection, scarring, asymmetry, implant shifting or hardening, and need for revision. It is surgery under anaesthesia and should be assessed by a qualified plastic surgeon.

chain: Implant shaped like the pectoralis placed over or under the muscle
Adds volume and contour to the chest
angle.text: The implant adds volume without relying on muscle growth. It is used by men with underdeveloped or asymmetrical chests and in reconstruction.

lead: Pectoral implants are soft, solid silicone implants designed to mimic the size and shape of the pectoralis major, placed to enhance or restore the male chest [1]. A 1991 review in Clinics in Plastic Surgery described implants developed in several sizes and shapes to match the muscle and nipple-areolar complex, with soft solid silicone of similar height, length and thickness to the muscle [1].

They serve people seeking chest enhancement, those with muscular atrophy or injury, and patients with congenital chest differences; an Aesthetic Plastic Surgery series of 21 patients used manufactured, custom-made implants in three groups: 18 seeking enhancement, one with muscle atrophy and two with muscle injuries [2]. The authors reported satisfying results [2].

The topic is also discussed on bodybuilding forum T Nation, where members have commented on a perceived increase in men getting silicone pectoral implants and on their own opinions of the operation [3][4].
infobox: Men seeking chest enhancement; atrophy, injury, congenital difference [2]

paras: Implants are produced in a range of sizes and shapes to follow the pectoralis major, and are soft solid silicone rather than gel-filled [1]. The 1991 review also noted improved gynecomastia techniques, including liposuction with circum-areolar excision, helping surgeons obtain a smooth, flat chest [1].

In T Nation threads from 2002 and 2008, members reacted to male pectoral implants; one 2002 poster called them equally unwise as breast implants, and a 2008 poster pointed to a news report that silicone pectoral implants were on the rise [3][4]. These are individual opinions, not survey data.

Evidence is limited to surgical series. A 2008 Aesthetic Plastic Surgery report of 21 patients using custom-made pectoral implants described technique and reported satisfying results, including enhancement of the chest [2]. A 1991 review covers implant design and gynecomastia correction [1]. A 2024 paper on Poland syndrome describes surgical algorithms for chest-wall reconstruction [5].

lore.intro: Pectoral implants are mentioned on bodybuilding forums as an alternative to training or as a topic of debate [3][4].
